messages:
emma: Quick follow-up from todays all-hands: can we get precise windows for API v2 canary/GA, Console beta freeze, and Optimize quant advisor pilot? Teams need dates to plan.

raj: Short: canary ~6 weeks, GA ~13 weeks; Console freeze ~7 weeks, public beta ~10 weeks; Optimize pilot onboarding target: in 3-4 weeks.

micah: Main API risk: intermittent KV-cache invalidation on long sessions that raises p95 ~25-35%. We'll post a repro tonight.

sara: Console beta will include per-route cost UI, simple rollout controls, and a prompt-eval panel. Tracing and advanced RBAC deferred.

owen: Optimize needs 2 pilot customers who can share anonymized prompts; without pilots in 3 weeks rollout slips by a sprint. Advisor will be opt-in and show confidence + est cost delta.

leah: I'll coordinate SDK smoke tests for JS/Python/mobile. @raj please link the compatibility spec.

raj: Putting the spec and a draft canary gating checklist in the follow-up doc. Gates: SDK smoke tests, 48h rate-limiter soak at 2x bursts, regression perf guards (p95 delta <10%).

deploy-bot: [placeholder] Tentative API v2 canary window: 2026-05-18 to 2026-05-20 UTC. Will finalize after gating.

emma: Leadership asks: confirm infra availability for a dedicated canary by EOD tomorrow; product to surface pilot candidates for Optimize in 3 weeks. Any blockers?

micah: No blockers from infra side but will need timeboxed fix for KV repro if it reproduces during soak.

sara: Will surface candidates and flag any privacy constraints.

leah: Confirming infra EOD tomorrow and will post smoke-test owners.

emma: Thanks. Please add playbook link, KV repro, SDK test list, and pilot names to the all-hands follow-up doc and ping me if anything slides. :thumbsup:
